incompatible.app_too_old: The app needs to be updated.
incompatible.desktop_too_old: Porecatu needs to be updated on the computer.
app_lock.unavailable_warning: This device has no screen lock, so the app cannot be locked. Set one up in the system settings.
app_lock.lockout: Biometrics are unavailable for now. Use the device passcode.
desktops.title: Desktops
desktops.empty_body: In Porecatu on your computer, turn on remote access and show the QR code. Then tap Pair desktop.
desktops.load_error: Could not read the paired desktops.
desktops.remove_body: This device still shows as paired in Porecatu on that computer until you revoke it there.
desktops.rename_failed: Could not save the new name on this device.
desktops.remove_failed: Could not remove the desktop from this device.
pairing.camera_permission_body: The app needs the camera to read the QR code that Porecatu shows on your computer. The image never leaves the device.
pairing.camera_permission_denied: Camera access was denied. To read the QR code, allow the camera in the system settings.
pairing.scan_instruction: Point at the Porecatu QR code
pairing.camera_busy: The camera is in use by another app.
pairing.device_name_hint: Shown in Porecatu so you can recognize the device.
pairing.waiting_for_desktop: Confirm in Porecatu on your computer.
pairing.compare_fingerprint: Compare this fingerprint with the one it shows:
pairing.identity_mismatch_title: This computer is not who the code said it was
pairing.identity_mismatch: The identity it presented does not match the one in the QR code. Nothing was sent or saved. Do not try again with this code.
pairing.host_unavailable: The desktop is not connected to the relay. Check that Porecatu is open on the computer.
pairing.connection_lost: The connection dropped before the pairing finished.
pairing.list_full: The list already has {max} desktops. Remove one to pair another.
pairing.storage_failed: The paired desktop could not be saved on this device.
pairing_uri.not-porecatu: This QR code is not from Porecatu.
pairing_uri.unsupported-version: This code is from a Porecatu version the app does not understand. Update the app or Porecatu.
pairing_uri.insecure-relay: The code points to a relay without a secure connection (wss). For safety, the app does not connect.
pairing_uri.invalid-relay: The relay address in this QR code is not valid.
pairing_uri.missing-param: This QR code is not from Porecatu.
pairing_uri.duplicate-param: This QR code repeats a field.
pairing_uri.malformed-param: This QR code has a field that is not valid.
pairing_uri.bad-key-length: The desktop key in this QR code has the wrong size.
pairing_uri.bad-token-length: The pairing token in this QR code has the wrong size.
pairing_uri.bad-name: The desktop name in this QR code is not valid.
pair_rejected.token-invalid: The QR code expired or was already used. Generate another one in Porecatu.
pair_rejected.user-declined: The pairing was declined on the computer.
pair_rejected.timeout: The computer did not answer in time. Try again.
goodbye.remote-disabled: Remote access was turned off in Porecatu.
goodbye.revoked: This device was revoked in Porecatu.
close_reason.host-replaced: The desktop connected to the relay again.
close_reason.host-gone: The desktop lost its connection to the relay.
close_reason.host-rejected: The desktop refused the connection. Remote access may be turned off.
close_reason.protocol-error: The relay received an invalid message.
socket_close.unsupported-data: The relay refused a text message.
socket_close.message-too-big: A message was larger than the relay allows.
socket_close.registration-refused: The relay refused the desktop registration.
socket_close.replaced: The connection was replaced by a newer one.
socket_close.invalid-envelope: The relay received an invalid message.
socket_close.registration-timeout: The registration did not finish in time.
socket_close.unknown: The connection to the relay was closed.
error.not-paired: This device is no longer paired with this desktop.
error.unknown-window: That no longer exists on the desktop.
error.unknown-group: That no longer exists on the desktop.
error.unknown-tab: That no longer exists on the desktop.
error.unknown-pane: That no longer exists on the desktop.
error.unknown-profile: That profile no longer exists. The list was updated.
error.too-many-subscriptions: Could not open this pane right now.
error.invalid-argument: The desktop did not accept this request.
error.busy: The desktop has a dialog open. Try again.
error.confirm-timeout: Time is up: nothing was closed.
error.unsupported: The desktop does not support this action.
error.last-tab: The last tab of the desktop cannot be closed.
error.unknown: The desktop reported an error this app does not recognize.

settings.bell_vibration_description: A short vibration when the open pane rings the bell.
settings.save_failed: The setting could not be saved.

device.recreate_title: Recreate the identity of this device?
device.recreate_body: All pairings will be lost: the app deletes the key and the desktop list. You will have to pair each one again and revoke this device on the computers.
device.recreate_reason: Recreate the identity of this device
device.recreate_failed: The identity of this device could not be recreated.

panes.subtitle.other: {count} panes · the focused pane on the desktop does not change

new_group.title: New group with this tab
group_color.title: Group color

toast.action_busy: Wait for the previous action to finish.
